title: Genting Highlands Day Trip from KL by Private Driver
metaDescription: Plan a Genting Highlands day trip from KL with your own driver: Awana SkyWay, Chin Swee Temple, the Premium Outlets, timings and what to pack.

contentBlocks.content: A Genting Highlands day trip from KL works well with your own driver. Book an 8 or 10 hour car charter on ttklia.com and you are collected at your hotel. Ride the Awana SkyWay cable car up the mountain, stop at Chin Swee Caves Temple on the same ticket, and shop at Genting Highlands Premium Outlets on the way down. The drive from KL to the outlets takes a little under an hour.
Key Takeaways
How long is the drive? A little under an hour from Kuala Lumpur to Genting Highlands Premium Outlets, where the cable car starts.
How much is the cable car? RM19 return in a standard gondola on the Awana SkyWay. Children under 90 cm ride free.
Is the theme park open every day? No. Genting SkyWorlds closes on Tuesdays, except Malaysian national public holidays and school holidays.
What should I wear? Bring a light jacket. Resorts World Genting describes the climate as 15 to 25 degrees Celsius.
Why go with your own driver

A tour runs on someone else's clock. A car charter runs on yours. ttklia.com sells 8 and 10 hour charters with a driver, and the charter covers Genting Highlands. You choose the car by group size when you book; the listed cars run from 4 seats up to the 10 seat Mercedes Sprinter.

Book at least 24 hours ahead. After you pay, ttklia support confirms your itinerary and your car and driver details, and your driver is arranged the day before. On the day, you can change the plan within the agreed scope. Before you pay, ask what is included: fuel, tolls, parking, and whether the drive up and back counts in your hours.

content.heading: Book a car with driver for Genting
content.subheading: 8 or 10 hours with a driver, picked up at your KL hotel. Ask what is included when you book.

contentBlocks.content: A day plan from KL

1. Morning: leave your hotel. Your driver takes the E8 expressway towards Genting Highlands, a little under an hour from KL.
  2. Get dropped at Sky Sentral. It adjoins Genting Highlands Premium Outlets, and it is where the Awana SkyWay starts.
  3. Ride the Awana SkyWay up. About 10 minutes from Sky Sentral to the Genting Highlands Station at the top.
  4. Stop at Chin Swee Caves Temple on the way, at Chin Swee Station. Keep your ticket to carry on up.
  5. Spend the middle of the day at the top. Pick the theme park or the indoor malls and restaurants.
  6. Ride down and shop. The outlets are open 10AM to 10PM.
  7. Head back to KL with your driver before the evening traffic.
Times on the mountain vary with queues and weather, so tell your driver your rough plan when you book.
Awana SkyWay tickets and hours
The Awana SkyWay runs from 7AM to 11PM. Fares from Resorts World Genting, checked on 11 October 2026:

TicketOne wayReturn
Standard gondola (8 to 10 people, shared)RM11RM19
Standard gondola with express boardingRM17RM32
Glass floor gondola (6 people, shared)RM32 (RM29 online)RM54 (RM48 online)
Chartered gondola (private)RM324RM594
Senior citizen, standardRM6RM10

Online glass floor tickets must be bought at least one day before. Tickets bought ahead are valid for 30 days. Each passenger can bring one cabin size bag; an oversized bag costs RM22 one way or RM38 return. Store bigger bags at the baggage counter on Level 2 of Sky Sentral, open 24 hours, from RM22.

Maintenance, 12 to 16 October 2026. The Awana SkyWay closes for quarterly maintenance on those dates. The Genting SkyWay, the resort's other cable car, runs from 7AM to 11PM instead. If your trip falls in that window, ask your driver to take you to its station.
Chin Swee Caves Temple

Chin Swee Caves Temple sits on a rocky slope near the peak. Look for the nine storey lamp lit pagoda, the open air SkyTerrace and a 15 metre statue of Buddha. The stop at Chin Swee Station is free on your Awana SkyWay ticket. Keep the ticket or QR code, because you need it to continue to the top. Dress respectfully for a temple, then take the next gondola up.
Theme park or shopping

Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park opens daily from 10am to 6pm and closes on Tuesdays, except Malaysian national public holidays and school holidays. A standard ticket is RM198, or RM168 online if you buy at least one day ahead. A theme park day takes most of your hours, so book the 10 hour charter if you plan one.

Not riding? Spend the time in the malls and restaurants at the top, then leave room for Genting Highlands Premium Outlets on the way down. It is 10 minutes from Resorts World Genting. For more ideas, read things to do in Bukit Bintang for the evening back in KL.
What to bring

• A light jacket. Resorts World Genting gives the climate as 15 to 25 degrees Celsius.
  • Your cable car ticket on your phone. You need it again at Chin Swee Station.
  • Respectful clothing for the temple.
  • Mobile data to message your driver for pickup. See tourist SIM cards in Malaysia.
Pack the night before, then confirm your pickup time with your driver.
Frequently Asked Questions
Is one day enough for a Genting Highlands day trip?
Yes, one day is enough for a Genting Highlands day trip if you pick one main activity: the theme park, or the cable car, temple and outlets. The drive from KL takes a little under an hour each way.
How much is the Awana SkyWay cable car?
The Awana SkyWay cable car costs RM11 one way or RM19 return in a standard gondola. The glass floor gondola costs RM32 one way or RM54 return, or less online a day ahead.
Can I stop at Chin Swee Temple on the way up?
Yes, you can stop at Chin Swee Temple on the way up at no extra cost. Get off at Chin Swee Station and keep your ticket to carry on to the top.
Is Genting SkyWorlds open every day?
No, Genting SkyWorlds is not open every day. It closes on Tuesdays, except Malaysian national public holidays and school holidays, and opens 10am to 6pm on other days.
Conclusion

For a Genting Highlands day trip from KL, leave in the morning, ride the Awana SkyWay up with a stop at Chin Swee, and shop at the outlets on the way down. Check the maintenance dates and SkyWorlds' Tuesday closure before you pick a day. Book an 8 or 10 hour car charter on ttklia.com and ask what is included when you book.
